A future study with a large sample size is warranted. Last, we could not use the total lesion counts because of the variability in the imaging protocol. However, Christine K. Fox et al. revealed that large CCM lesion (a least 5 mm) counts are more associated with early-onset seizure than total lesion counts. 11
